summary: Files must not exist in obsolete directories like test/runner/ (now test/lib/ansible_test/) or most of test/sanity/; rebase old branches to put changes in the right place.
questions: Why does my PR fail the obsolete-files test?

answer_card.title: obsolete-files test
answer_card.answer_md:
- `test/runner/` → `test/lib/ansible_test/`
- most `test/sanity/` subdirs → `test/lib/ansible_test/_util/controller/sanity/`

Usually hits old PRs; update your branch and move the changes.
